_what: The rate at which ARBITRARY 16-mers let a mature wild-type parent transcript pair the whole catalytic gap at >= 10 contiguous base pairs — the null that screen 4's 87 of 190 had been reported without.
_why: A count with no null cannot be large or small. The genome scan states a chance expectation per 16-mer; the mature-parent screen did not, so its headline had no anchor. Raised by external review of the submission manuscript, 2026-08-15.
_what_this_is_not: Not a significance test. The 190 design records are 176 distinct molecules tiled at overlapping registers across 38 junctions, so they are not independent draws and no test treating them as such would be right about its own denominator. Proportions carry Wilson intervals; the per-design paired rate is the honest comparison.
Not a measurement of off-target activity. A duplex is necessary for RNase-H1 cleavage and is not sufficient, and a scrambled oligonucleotide clearing this screen is not thereby safe.
Not transcriptome-wide — six parent transcripts, the bound screen 4 itself carries.
Not a null for any other screen. Screens 1, 2, 3 and 5 have their own bounds.
_cost: $0 — offline, over two committed artifacts, no network and no credentials.

method.instrument: aso_parent_gap_pairing.longest_run_through_gap, unchanged — same six mature parents, forward orientation only, same MIN_DUPLEX_BP. Only the query changes.
method.prng: splitmix64, written out in aso_parent_null.py for bit-stability

analytic_expectation._what: What an independent-uniform-base 16-mer should meet, computed rather than assumed, so the measured ensembles have something to be checked against.
analytic_expectation._checks_the_measured_ensembles: This is the quantity `random_uniform` estimates by sampling, so the two are a check on each other; Poisson sits slightly high because sites within one transcript overlap rather than arriving independently.
analytic_expectation._caveat: Independent uniform bases. Real transcript sequence is composition-skewed and repetitive, so this separates 'more than chance' from 'at chance' and nothing finer — the same qualification the manuscript's genome-scan null carries.

observed._agrees_with_screen_4: This arm is re-measured through the index rather than copied from aso-parent-gap-pairing.json; the two agree by test.

cut_sensitivity._what: The same instrument read at 7 contiguous base pairs, the loose end of the cited range, beside 10, the strict end the manuscript reports throughout.
cut_sensitivity._why: The manuscript disclosed the loose reading as the more inclusive reading of the liability. Measured, it is not a reading of the liability at all: at 7 the exon-terminus chimera null is within a percentage point of the observed rate, so the loose count is what any chimera between two real transcripts gives and carries no information about this disease's breakpoints. The strict cut is the one on which the observed rate stands clear of every null, which is why it is the one reported.
cut_sensitivity._read_with: null_ensembles[*]['at_7bp'], which carries every ensemble at the loose cut so neither count is quoted without its anchor.
